definitions.explanation: talking excessively, sometimes to the point of being annoying or indiscreet

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}は{酒|さけ}を{飲|の}むと{饒舌|じょうぜつ}になる。
examples.english: He becomes talkative when he drinks.

examples.japanese: {饒舌|じょうぜつ}な{人|ひと}は{秘密|ひみつ}を{守|まも}れない。
{普段|ふだん}{無口|むくち}な{彼女|かのじょ}が{今日|きょう}は{饒舌|じょうぜつ}だった。
examples.english: She, who is usually quiet, was talkative today.

notes:
NUANCE:
{饒舌|じょうぜつ} often carries a slightly negative connotation, implying excessive talking or poor discretion. It can also be neutral, simply describing someone who talks a lot.

OPPOSITE:
- {無口|むくち} - quiet, taciturn, reticent
- {寡黙|かもく} - silent, taciturn (more formal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- おしゃべり - chatty, talkative (casual, often positive or neutral)
- {多弁|たべん} - talkative, verbose (neutral to slightly negative)
- {口数|くちかず}が{多|おお}い - talks a lot

USAGE:
More literary/formal than おしゃべり.
